onset.Description: Seconds from the EDF start time (header start, wall clock) to the event, computed from the deposit annotation CSV timestamps before date scrubbing. For EDF+D (discontinuous) files this is wall-clock time, not sample count (gaps: sourcedata/edf_discontinuities.tsv).

duration.Description: Stop minus start where the source gives a stop time, else n/a.

Levels.platform_annotation: databricks_events.csv (patient annotation through the human-AI platform)

event_text.Description: Free-text comment / description from the source CSV (Comment, description or annotation column).

response_onset.Description: databricks_events.csv response_time (when the patient answered the platform's seizure query), as seconds from the EDF start time, like onset. The absolute timestamp stays only in sourcedata/annots (day set to 01). May exceed the recording span.

source.Description: Source CSV in raw_data/annots/<PennEPI id>/ (scrubbed copy in sourcedata/annots/).
